title: Ritchey Classic Bigfoot Pedals
content:
Are you a fan of Ritchey and love its Bigfoot pedals but wish they came in metal? Well, today the brand rolled out just that: metal Classic Bigfoot pedals ($119.95).

The Classic Bigfoot’s alloy platform is 105 x 108.5 mm wide and 18.5 mm deep. Ten replaceable steel pins per side dig in and hold on loose singletrack, wet pavement, or gravel roads that go longer than expected. The concave shape keeps your foot centered without thinking about it. And CroMo axles run on a bushing inner bearing and sealed cartridge outer bearing, built for longevity and easy maintenance. The Bigfoot pedals are machined from extruded 6061 alloy and weigh about 445 grams per pair.

Specs:

  • Stable alloy platform for confident foot placement
  • Ten replaceable steel pins per side grip in wet, loose, and mixed conditions
  • Concave shape keeps your foot centered naturally
  • CroMo axles and sealed bearings built for long-term reliability
  • Replaceable pins extend the life of the pedal
  • Your Crocs are welcome here

Check out more at Ritchey.
